### Custom voice generation with Qwen3TTSModel

Source: https://github.com/qwenlm/qwen3-tts/blob/main/README.md

Loads a Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice model and generates speech for a single text or a batch of texts. The single inference uses the 'Vivian' speaker with a Chinese instruction; the batch inference uses different speakers and languages. The model must be loaded with torch.float16 or torch.bfloat16 to use flash_attention_2.

```python
import torch
import soundfile as sf
from qwen_tts import Qwen3TTSModel

model = Qwen3TTSModel.from_pretrained(
    "Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice",
    device_map="cuda:0",
    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    attn_implementation="flash_attention_2",
)

# single inference
wavs, sr = model.generate_custom_voice(
    text="其实我真的有发现，我是一个特别善于观察别人情绪的人。",
    language="Chinese", # Pass `Auto` (or omit) for auto language adaptive; if the target language is known, set it explicitly.
    speaker="Vivian",
    instruct="用特别愤怒的语气说", # Omit if not needed.
)
sf.write("output_custom_voice.wav", wavs[0], sr)

# batch inference
wavs, sr = model.generate_custom_voice(
    text=[
        "其实我真的有发现，我是一个特别善于观察别人情绪的人。", 
        "She said she would be here by noon."
    ],
    language=["Chinese", "English"],
    speaker=["Vivian", "Ryan"],
    instruct=["", "Very happy."]
)
sf.write("output_custom_voice_1.wav", wavs[0], sr)
sf.write("output_custom_voice_2.wav", wavs[1], sr)
```

### get_supported_speakers / get_supported_languages

Source: https://github.com/qwenlm/qwen3-tts/blob/main/_autodocs/api-reference/qwen3-tts-for-conditional-generation.md

Return the supported speaker IDs and language codes. These methods provide the available speakers and languages for the TTS model.

```APIDOC
## get_supported_speakers / get_supported_languages

### Description
Return the `supported_speakers` keys view (`spk_id` keys; e.g. `"vivian", "serena", ...`) and the `supported_languages` list (`["auto", ...]` without dialect keys; dialects are reachable via the auto/speaker-dialect path).

### Methods
- `get_supported_speakers(self)`
- `get_supported_languages(self)`

### Returns
- `get_supported_speakers`: A view of the supported speaker keys.
- `get_supported_languages`: A list of supported language codes.

### Example
```python
print(list(model.get_supported_speakers()), model.get_supported_languages())
```
```

### Age as a training attribute in premium timbres

Source: https://github.com/qwenlm/qwen3-tts/blob/main/README.md

Shows that age is one of the multi-dimensional training attributes encoded in the 9 premium timbres for the CustomVoice model, alongside gender, language, and dialect.

```markdown
| Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice | Provides style control over target timbres via user instructions; supports 9 premium timbres covering various combinations of gender, age, language, and dialect. | Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian | ✅ | ✅ |
| Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice | Supports 9 premium timbres covering various combinations of gender, age, language, and dialect. | Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian | ✅ |  |
```

--------------------------------

### Standard inference dtype is bfloat16 with flash-attention-2

Source: https://github.com/qwenlm/qwen3-tts/blob/main/README.md

Every model-loading example in the README uses dtype=torch.bfloat16 and attn_implementation=flash_attention_2 as the standard configuration for the 1.7B VoiceDesign model.

```python
model = Qwen3TTSModel.from_pretrained(
    "Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign",
    device_map="cuda:0",
    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    attn_implementation="flash_attention_2",
)
```
